case.t0_rule: WHO declaration of a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (docs/DAC_PPE_CODING.md §2)
case.response_scale: Dutch national government (ministry of VWS; from 23 March with the LCH); regional (ROAZ, GGD) and institutional acts are context
case.start_rule: First national purchase order or contract for PPE for general supply; inquiries, offers, tenders and EU joint procurement excluded

inclusion_rules.firm_order: First national purchase of PPE for general supply
inclusion_rules.binding_act: First legally binding national act concerning the PPE response
inclusion_rules.dedicated_funding: First funding legally earmarked for PPE
inclusion_rules.delivery: First physical delivery of nationally procured PPE to the ROAZ networks; deliveries directly to care providers are a secondary end point
inclusion_rules.institutionalisation: First permanent body created for the hazard

observation_window.reason: First wave; opens 1 Jan so that pre-t0 events can be context (docs/DAC_PPE_CODING.md §5)

searched: Ministerie van VWS (2021), Feitenreconstructie, tijdlijn: Persoonlijke beschermingsmiddelen (full, 39 pp.; eerstekamer.nl; sha256 237fcdb5...)
not_accessed: internal sources cited by the reconstruction (sitraps, consignment reports)

case.identification: Not testable: the only order linked to a delivery (the 21 March shipment) has no order date.

events.description: WHO declares a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (not in the Dutch source; cited from the Belgian chronology, rule §5 Germany a)
events.source: Chambre, Commission spéciale COVID-19, DOC 55 1394/002 (2021), Annexe 5, PDF p. 342, row 36 (CRIV K001, De Raedt)
Chambre, Commission spéciale COVID-19, DOC 55 1394/002 (2021), Annexe 5, PDF p. 363, row 51 (CRIV K001, De Raedt)

events.description: VWS starts an inventory of available PPE with the LNAZ and the safety regions, on advice of the BAO [grey text in the source: oral source without documents]
events.source: Ministerie van VWS (2021), Feitenreconstructie, tijdlijn: Persoonlijke beschermingsmiddelen, januari-juli 2020, PDF p. 6

events.description: BAO advises a distribution structure for PPE via the ROAZ networks (formalised with the LCH on 23 March)
events.source: Ministerie van VWS (2021), Feitenreconstructie, tijdlijn: Persoonlijke beschermingsmiddelen, januari-juli 2020, PDF p. 8 and p. 20

events.description: Registration opens for the first EU joint procurement of PPE; the Netherlands registers (tender, not a Dutch order)
events.source: Ministerie van VWS (2021), Feitenreconstructie, tijdlijn: Persoonlijke beschermingsmiddelen, januari-juli 2020, PDF p. 8

events.description: Agreement that care institutions outside the ROAZ structure can report to the ROAZ and receive PPE within three hours (from existing regional stocks; not a national delivery) [grey text in the source: oral source without documents]
events.source: Ministerie van VWS (2021), Feitenreconstructie, tijdlijn: Persoonlijke beschermingsmiddelen, januari-juli 2020, PDF p. 9

events.description: First national purchase of PPE: VWS actively helps the NFU with purchasing from 6 March; on 9 March the ministry's directorate 'heeft op dit moment 500.000 mondmaskers gekocht' (rule §5 Netherlands a)
events.source: Ministerie van VWS (2021), Feitenreconstructie, tijdlijn: Persoonlijke beschermingsmiddelen, januari-juli 2020, PDF p. 9
events.source_wording: 'VWS helpt de NFU vanaf 6 maart actief met de inkoop van persoonlijke beschermingsmiddelen' … 'Op 9 maart … De directie heeft op dit moment 500.000 mondmaskers gekocht' (p. 9)

events.description: Minister to the Tweede Kamer: a start has been made with the purchase and distribution of masks by the ROAZ networks
events.source: Ministerie van VWS (2021), Feitenreconstructie, tijdlijn: Persoonlijke beschermingsmiddelen, januari-juli 2020, PDF p. 9

events.description: Minister: 'morgen de eerste 500.000 mondmaskers aankomen' (announced arrival, not a delivery)
events.source: Ministerie van VWS (2021), Feitenreconstructie, tijdlijn: Persoonlijke beschermingsmiddelen, januari-juli 2020, PDF p. 9

events.description: The ministry redistributes about 200,000 masks of various types to care providers in the week before its letter of 20 March (secondary end point: providers; rule §5 Netherlands c)
events.source: Ministerie van VWS (2021), Feitenreconstructie, tijdlijn: Persoonlijke beschermingsmiddelen, januari-juli 2020, PDF p. 10
events.source_wording: 'Via die weg heeft de minister de afgelopen week in ieder geval rond de 200.000 verschillende typen mondmaskers kunnen herverdelen over zorgaanbieders in Nederland' (letter of 20 March, p. 10)

events.description: Cabinet decides not to prepare a requisition decree for PPE
events.source: Ministerie van VWS (2021), Feitenreconstructie, tijdlijn: Persoonlijke beschermingsmiddelen, januari-juli 2020, PDF p. 10

events.description: Order by VWS, via an intermediary, of the first shipment of masks from China (about 690,000 KN95/FFP2); order date not given (rule §5 Netherlands d)
events.source: Ministerie van VWS (2021), Feitenreconstructie, tijdlijn: Persoonlijke beschermingsmiddelen, januari-juli 2020, PDF p. 11

events.description: First shipment from China (about 690,000 masks) arrives 21 March, goes to central storage and is distributed 'onder alle ROAZ-regio's'; by 22 March part 'was reeds uitgeleverd aan zorgaanbieders' (rule §5 Netherlands b)
events.source: Ministerie van VWS (2021), Feitenreconstructie, tijdlijn: Persoonlijke beschermingsmiddelen, januari-juli 2020, PDF p. 11 and p. 18
events.source_wording: 'Eerste lading van zo’n 690.000 mondmaskers is net binnen' (tweet of 21 March) … 'via die opslag verdeeld onder alle ROAZ-regio’s' (p. 11); 'Een deel van deze zending was reeds uitgeleverd aan zorgaanbieders' (signal of 22 March, p. 18)

events.description: Landelijk Consortium Hulpmiddelen (LCH) starts: joint national purchasing and distribution (not described as permanent)
events.source: Ministerie van VWS (2021), Feitenreconstructie, tijdlijn: Persoonlijke beschermingsmiddelen, januari-juli 2020, PDF p. 14

events.description: Zero VAT rate on face masks from 25 May (aimed at public-transport users; announced 13 May)
events.source: Ministerie van VWS (2021), Feitenreconstructie, tijdlijn: Persoonlijke beschermingsmiddelen, januari-juli 2020, PDF p. 32

events.description: No legally binding national act concerning the PPE response in the window found (the cabinet decided on 20 March not to prepare a requisition decree)
events.source: Ministerie van VWS (2021), Feitenreconstructie, tijdlijn: Persoonlijke beschermingsmiddelen, januari-juli 2020, searched in full

events.description: No legally earmarked funding for PPE found ('financiële garantstellingen' from 6 March are guarantees, p. 9)
events.source: Ministerie van VWS (2021), Feitenreconstructie, tijdlijn: Persoonlijke beschermingsmiddelen, januari-juli 2020, searched in full

events.description: No permanent body for the hazard found (the LCH is not described as permanent)
events.source: Ministerie van VWS (2021), Feitenreconstructie, tijdlijn: Persoonlijke beschermingsmiddelen, januari-juli 2020, searched in full
